say:38:1064603027:1.text: The gardener confirms the butler's account. He tried to pocket the sapphire at first, but the butler caught him in the act.

say:40:1064603029:1.source_cn: 你努力在一大堆无用的信息中找到关键点，神情逐渐变得不耐...

say:40:1064603029:1.female: Sensing your impatience, the stablehand politely tips his cap, revealing his receding hairline, before quietly slipping away.

say:41:1064603030:1.source_cn: 园丁的话匣子还在继续。

say:42:1064603031:1.text: ... Lady Lambert hasn't been herself since her father kicked the bucket.

say:42:1064603031:1.female: ... Lady Lambert hasn't been herself since her father kicked the bucket.

say:48:1064603037:0.female: You gaze upon the sprawling main building of Lambert Manor, which seems to have lost its former vitality since its master's passing. The scent of wax and aged wood lingers in the air.

say:4:1064603003:0.text: The butler ushers you into the main hall, where you meet Blair Lambert.
say:4:1064603003:0.source_cn: 经管家引荐，你在主厅与现任家主布蕾兹相见。
say:4:1064603003:0.male: The butler ushers you into the main hall, where you meet Blair Lambert.
say:4:1064603003:0.female: The butler ushers you into the main hall, where you meet Blair Lambert.

say:52:1064603040:1.text: The hallway behind you is empty.
say:52:1064603040:1.source_cn: 身后只有空荡荡的走廊。

say:56:1064603043:1.female: The thick carpet muffles your footsteps as you make your way to the other end of the hallway. Something feels... off.

say:57:1064603044:1.text: You look up and catch sight of a silver sword mounted on the wall.
say:57:1064603044:1.source_cn: 抬眼一瞧，墙上挂着把银色的礼仪剑。

say:58:1064603045:1.source_cn: 这是老爷的收藏，产自奎林城，是他很喜欢的佩剑。

say:61:1064603047:1.female: Then you should be able to tell.

say:64:1064603050:0.female: You nod to the butler, but your gaze lingers on the sword. Suddenly, that unsettling feeling of being watched returns.

say:67:1064603051:0.text: You rush down the stairs, just in time to glimpse a figure disappearing around the corner near the kitchen. But by the time you get there, there's no one in sight.

say:68:1064603052:1.text: The butler calls in the guards to search the manor, but they find no trace of anyone suspicious.
say:68:1064603052:1.source_cn: 管家呼叫警卫来对宅邸进行彻查，却没有发现任何可疑人士。

say:69:1064603053:0.text: You check with the guards and confirm that the burglary was indeed reported. With the afternoon to spare, you explore the rest of the estate.
say:69:1064603053:0.source_cn: 你从警卫口中验证了朗贝尔宅失窃的报警信息，又趁下午时间...

say:70:1064603054:0.text: Although you no longer sense anyone watching you, you decide to spend the night at the manor to continue your investigation.
say:70:1064603054:0.source_cn: 被人注视的感觉不再出现，但你决定在庄园里留宿一夜，以便...

say:70:1064603054:0.female: Although you no longer sense anyone watching you, you decide to spend the night at the manor to continue your investigation.

say:73:1064603056:0.male: Your guest room is ready, sir.
say:73:1064603056:0.female: Your guest room is ready, madam.

say:74:1064603057:0.text: And... I must ask that you refrain from wandering the halls late at night, sir. Lady Lambert is still grieving her father's passing, and any unexpected disturbance may cause her distress.

say:77:1064603058:0.female: At midnight, you slip on your coat and press your ear against the door.

say:78:1064603059:1.female: You listen intently and catch a faint rustling sound coming from the direction of the staircase.

say:79:1064603060:0.text: That suspicious person must be here again!
say:79:1064603060:0.source_cn: 那个可疑的家伙就在这里！

say:7:1064603005:0.text: My father passed away recently, and things have been rather hectic around the estate. I do hope our servants have made you feel at home.

say:84:1064603064:1.source_cn: 你震惊地跨出隔音魔法的范围，盯着那个人。

say:84:1064603064:1.female: You step outside the range of your soundproofing spell, stunned by the sight before you.

say:86:1064603065:0.text: Ah, it's you, my dear friend. Do come in quickly. We mustn't disturb the household at this hour.
say:86:1064603065:0.source_cn: 啊，亲爱的梅林，快进来，别吵醒这里的主人。

say:8:1064603006:1.text: Now, to what do we owe the pleasure of your unexpected visit?

say:8:1064603006:1.male: Now, to what do we owe the pleasure of your unexpected visit?
say:8:1064603006:1.female: Now, to what do we owe the pleasure of your unexpected visit?

say:90:1064603071:1.text: Fret not. I've left enough clues for that red-haired young man to deduce my escape. By now, he should have released the poor guard who took my place in the dungeon.
